related.title: OpenID Connect：ID Token的受眾與時間驗證
related.titleEn: OpenID Connect: ID-token audience and time validation
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 public-test-vectors.json及正/負配對結果，沒有真實token。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver public-test-vectors.json and positive/negative bindings without live tokens.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 授權時效3600 s，教學策略接受now<4630；4631拒絕。有效時間但aud不含本client或nonce不符也一律拒絕。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Lifetime is3600 s,and the teaching policy accepts now<4630;4631 fails. An audience or nonce mismatch must fail even within the time window. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 32*8 = 256 bits；對照 ceil(32*8/6) = 43 characters。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
用hashlib SHA-256與urlsafe_b64encode計算固定向量，必須與RFC附錄預期相同；固定向量只能測試，不得用於真實登入。

基準 4600-1000 = 3600 s；對照 4600+30 = 4630 s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
授權時效3600 s，教學策略接受now<4630；4631拒絕。有效時間但aud不含本client或nonce不符也一律拒絕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 32*8 = 256 bits; comparison ceil(32*8/6) = 43 characters. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Compute the fixed vector with hashlib SHA-256 and URL-safe base64,matching the RFC result;the fixed vector is test-only.

Baseline 4600-1000 = 3600 s; comparison 4600+30 = 4630 s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Lifetime is3600 s,and the teaching policy accepts now<4630;4631 fails. An audience or nonce mismatch must fail even within the time window.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: xv6：系統呼叫與使用者／核心邊界
related.titleEn: xv6: system calls and user/kernel boundaries
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 public-test-vectors.json及正/負配對結果，沒有真實token。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver public-test-vectors.json and positive/negative bindings without live tokens.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 畫出user wrapper、trap、dispatch、copyin/copyout與return；以半開區間檢查整段而非起點。
related.differenceEn: Map wrapper, trap, dispatch, copyin/copyout and return; validate the entire half-open span instead of only its start.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 32*8 = 256 bits；對照 ceil(32*8/6) = 43 characters。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
用hashlib SHA-256與urlsafe_b64encode計算固定向量，必須與RFC附錄預期相同；固定向量只能測試，不得用於真實登入。

系統呼叫經trap轉入核心；使用者傳入的位址仍需檢查。教學核心揭露機制，不等同正式平台安全保證。
本課數值核對：8188+8-8192 = 4 B；另一項核對：8192-8188 = 4 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 32*8 = 256 bits; comparison ceil(32*8/6) = 43 characters. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Compute the fixed vector with hashlib SHA-256 and URL-safe base64,matching the RFC result;the fixed vector is test-only.

A system call traps into the kernel; user-supplied addresses still require validation. A teaching kernel reveals mechanisms, not production security guarantees.
Numeric audit: 8188+8-8192 = 4 B; second audit: 8192-8188 = 4 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
